title: 1901, July 4 Meeting the dignitaries at the train station
description: On the afternoon of July 4, 1901, Hartland was filled with excited citizens eager to witness history: the official opening of the Hartland toll bridge. Dr. Curtis chaired the ceremony, which began with a welcome address to the Premier, distinguished guests, and local citizens. The program featured several speeches, including a humorous one by Premier Tweedie, and mentioned the hopeful prospect of the bridge becoming toll-free in the future. The celebrations continued with a foot race and a ticket draw for a kerosene table lamp with a colorful shade, won by Charles Rideout. (Photo courtesy of Buddy Barss)
